instruction: Fix `tail` in `fileops/read.py`. It currently returns the FIRST `n` lines of a file instead of the LAST `n` lines.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops/read.py b/fileops/read.py
--- a/fileops/read.py
+++ b/fileops/read.py
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@
     """Return the last ``n`` lines of ``path`` (trailing newlines stripped)."""
     with open_text(path, "r") as handle:
         lines = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in handle]
-    return lines[:n]
+    return lines[-n:]
